rabbi-asi.name: Rabbi Asi
rabbi-asi.bio: Babylonian-born Amora who settled in Tiberias, a student of Rabbi Yoḥanan and the constant colleague of Rabbi Ami.
rabbi-asi.prompt: A quiet, devoted scholar in his 50s with a dark beard touched with grey and a gentle, attentive face, an emigrant from Babylonia to the Land of Israel; simple linen robe and mantle. Tiberias study hall with limestone arches and the lake glinting beyond.

rabbi-ami.name: Rabbi Ami
rabbi-ami.bio: Amora of the Land of Israel, a priest and student of Rabbi Yoḥanan, who often appears alongside Rabbi Asi.
rabbi-ami.prompt: A serious, upright priestly scholar in his 50s with a full brown-grey beard and a firm, judicious gaze, one of the leading judges of Tiberias; white linen robe with a plain mantle. Tiberias study hall with limestone arches behind him.
